title: post_api_webhooks_vapi_agencyid_valid_transcript_event
description: Verify that a POST request to /api/webhooks/vapi/[agencyId] with a valid transcript event payload returns a 200 status with { ok: true } and that the transcript event is correctly persisted in the call_events database table.

title: post_api_webhooks_vapi_agencyid_malformed_payload
description: Verify that a POST request to /api/webhooks/vapi/[agencyId] with a malformed payload returns a 500 status with { error: 'Internal error' } and that no transcript event is persisted in the call_events database table.

title: post_api_webhooks_vapi_agencyid_database_failure
description: Simulate a database failure during a POST request to /api/webhooks/vapi/[agencyId] and verify that the response is a 500 status with { error: 'Internal error' } and that no transcript event is persisted.
